h1: The Sun Resort Suphan Buri — a small resort by Bueng Chawak that actually has a pool
intro: If you're heading to Bueng Chawak Wildlife Park and want a small, quiet place within walking distance of the attractions that also has a pool to cool off in — The Sun Resort (also known as The Sun Resort Bungchawak) is a neat fit. It's a small resort of around 16 rooms in Doem Bang Nang Buat, just ~160 metres from the Bueng Chawak entrance, with bungalows and standard air-conditioned rooms, an outdoor pool, and breakfast included. Rates start at around ฿800/night — the trade-offs being a location ~55km from Suphan Buri city centre and the simple, homely feel of a small countryside resort.

body.html: The Sun Resort's main draw is how close it sits to Bueng Chawak Wildlife Park. It's only about 160 metres from the resort to the park entrance, so the aquarium, the zoo and the wide lake are a short walk or a one-minute drive away. If your trip is built around Bueng Chawak, you'll love being able to head in early before the crowds and pop back to the resort midday without driving anywhere.

The resort itself is a small property of around 16 rooms, laid out as bungalows and standard rooms in a garden. Rooms come with air conditioning, a TV, hot water and a little sitting area out front — simple and relaxed, the way countryside resorts tend to be. What sets it apart from other small stays around Bueng Chawak is that it has an outdoor swimming pool, which is a real bonus on hot days, especially if you're travelling with kids who want a dip after a day out.
"Rooms are small but clean, there's a pool for the kids, and you can walk to Bueng Chawak easily. The owners are friendly — a good base before heading in to explore."

On facilities, The Sun Resort keeps things simple. There's free Wi-Fi, free parking, breakfast, a restaurant/coffee shop, the swimming pool, bicycle rental and a fishing corner. The resort also hosts small functions and weddings, so there's a fair bit of garden and common space to wander. Overall it suits families or groups of friends who want a stay close to the attractions, with a pool, at a budget-friendly price.

To be straight with you, this is a small resort with simple, homely facilities and upkeep. Some rooms and fittings feel basic, and cleanliness and freshness can vary by room and season. The pool is on the small side — better for cooling off than serious swimming. If you're expecting polished rooms or city-hotel service you'll want to reset your expectations: the appeal here is the location by Bueng Chawak, the pool and the accessible price, not luxury.

One more thing to factor in is the distance from Suphan Buri town. The resort is in Doem Bang Nang Buat, around 55km from the city centre, and there aren't many restaurants or convenience stores nearby. You'll really want your own car, and it's worth bringing some snacks since the area goes quiet at night. But if your plan is Bueng Chawak specifically, this location takes the back-and-forth driving out of the equation — and you get a pool thrown in.

Overall, The Sun Resort scores around 7.4 out of 10 from real guest reviews on booking platforms (review numbers are still modest, as it's a small resort). It's a solid fit for families or groups set on visiting Bueng Chawak who want a stay near the attractions with a pool, and who are fine with a simple, homely resort. Rates start around ฿800 for a standard room on weekdays, rising to ฿1,000–฿1,200 for bungalows and weekends. Measured on its proximity to Bueng Chawak plus having a pool at this price, it's good value.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — The Sun Resort Suphan Buri

faq.q: Where is The Sun Resort in Suphan Buri, and what's nearby?
faq.a: The Sun Resort is at 111/1 Moo 3, Doem Bang, Doem Bang Nang Buat, Suphan Buri. It's very close to Bueng Chawak Wildlife Park — about 160 metres from the entrance — within walking distance of the aquarium and zoo. It's around 55km from Suphan Buri city centre and roughly a 40-minute drive from Samchuk Centenary Market.

faq.q: How much does The Sun Resort cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿800/night for a standard room on weekdays. Options include standard rooms, garden bungalows (around ฿1,200) and family bungalows sleeping about 4. Prices rise on weekends, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does The Sun Resort have a swimming pool?
faq.a: Yes — The Sun Resort has an outdoor swimming pool, which is what sets it apart from other small stays around Bueng Chawak. It's a small pool, better for cooling off after a day out than for serious swimming, and great for families with kids. Don't forget your swimwear.

faq.q: Who is The Sun Resort best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for families or groups of friends set on visiting Bueng Chawak who want a stay with a pool at a budget-friendly price. Because it's a small resort with simple facilities and sits well outside town, it's less suited to those wanting polished rooms or a city-centre base.

faq.q: Do I need my own car to get to The Sun Resort?
faq.a: You really should have your own car. The resort is in Doem Bang Nang Buat, around 55km from town, and restaurants and convenience stores nearby are limited. It's best to drive yourself and bring some snacks along, as the area goes quiet at night.

faq.q: Does The Sun Resort include breakfast and parking?
faq.a: Yes, both. The room rate includes breakfast, with free parking, free Wi-Fi and bicycle rental. There's a restaurant/coffee shop on site and a fishing corner in the common area to relax in.
